description: Resource files: read one, create any ClassDB resource as .tres, change one, write a shader, build a TileSet, or set a Theme colour or font size. A material is a create with resourceType StandardMaterial3D, ShaderMaterial or CanvasItemMaterial. read answers with the properties the file sets, in the form modify takes, and a Theme lists its items there as "Button/colors/font_color". move takes any file of the project, a script or an image as much as a resource, or a directory, and works from the files, so it needs no editor; one serving the project is brought up to it as after a move in its own FileSystem dock, its open scenes and cached resources named for the new paths and the project settings the move rewrote taken from the file. read needs no editor either: with none serving the project, a headless engine reads the file. The ops that write a resource need the editor connected. Operations: read: the properties a resource file sets; create (needs resourceType): a new resource of any class; modify (needs properties): set properties on an existing resource; create_shader (needs shaderType): a .gdshader file; create_tileset (needs sources): a TileSet from texture atlases; set_theme_color (needs controlType, colorName, color): a colour in a Theme; set_theme_font_size (needs controlType, fontSizeName, size): a font size in a Theme; move (needs newPath): move or rename a file or a directory, and every path in the project naming it.

code.description: create_shader: the shader source. Default: a minimal shader of that type. Only for op create_shader.

color.description: set_theme_color: r, g and b from 0 to 1, with a optional and opaque by default. Only for op set_theme_color.

colorName.description: set_theme_color: such as "font_color". Only for op set_theme_color.

controlType.description: Theme ops: the Control class, such as "Button". Only for ops set_theme_color, set_theme_font_size.

fontSizeName.description: set_theme_font_size: such as "font_size". Only for op set_theme_font_size.

includeDefaults.description: read: include properties still at their default. Default false. Only for op read.

newPath.description: move: where it goes, inside the project, and for a file with the extension it has. A file goes with its .import and .uid, and a directory with everything in it. Every path naming what moved in a scene, resource, script, project.godot or other text file is rewritten in the style it was written in, res:// or relative, and so is every relative path inside a moved file. A string naming it any other way, such as the start of a path built at run time, is answered under leftAlone rather than changed, and so is a scene or resource saved as .scn or .res, which this cannot rewrite. Only for op move.

preview.description: move: answer with what would move and change, and write nothing. Default false. Only for op move.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

properties.description: Properties to set, keyed by Godot property name. Vectors, colours and the like may be written as {"x": 1, "y": 2} or tagged {"_type": "Vector2", "x": 1, "y": 2}, which is the form a read answers with, so a value read off one node can be written straight to another. A key may also be a colon path into one of the components of a vector, a colour, a rectangle or a transform, as GDScript names them, so one axis is written alone: "position:x", "modulate:a", "region_rect:size:y"; a component the value does not have is refused, naming the ones it has. A property holding a node takes the path to it from the node being set, such as "../Player". Each value is read back once set, and one the engine changed or refused is refused with what it holds. Only for ops create, modify.

resourcePath.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres". move: a directory too. read: also a resource kept inside a scene or resource file, by the path a read answers a property holding it with, such as "res://hero.tscn::Animation_jump".

resourceType.description: create: the resource class, such as "PhysicsMaterial" or "StandardMaterial3D". Only for op create.

script.description: create: a script to attach, for custom resources. Only for op create.

size.description: set_theme_font_size: pixels. Only for op set_theme_font_size.

sources.description: Atlas sources, one per texture. Only for op create_tileset.

texture.description: File inside the project, such as "sprites/hero.png" or "materials/steel.tres".

name: resource_edit
title: Edit resources
